Name: Joel
Summary: Joel, son of Pethuel, prophesied to Judah, likely in the divided-monarchy period (his exact date is debated). Using a devastating locust plague as his picture, he called the people to repent and promised that God would pour out His Spirit on all flesh.
KeyStory: Joel saw locusts strip the land bare and called priests and people to a solemn fast and repentance, promising restoration and the outpouring of God's Spirit.
LifeLesson: When disaster strips everything bare, Joel's answer is not despair but return — rend your heart, not your garments, and God restores.
